mythology: Sati's breast (Stana-bhaga) fell on the Bhasmakuta hill of Gaya, sanctifying the rock as the supreme nourishing bosom of the Cosmic Mother.
festivals: Mangala Gauri Vrat (Tuesdays of Shravan month)
pilgrimage_significance: Essential pilgrimage stop in Gaya alongside Vishnupad and Falgu River; women observe the sacred Mangala Gauri Vrata here for the long life of spouses and familial bliss.
historical_notes: Mentioned in Agni Purana and Gaya Mahatmya; revered across Northern and Eastern India as a focal point of Shakti-welfare.
